note: Reads the LSM9DS1 every 10 ms, averages the last 16 samples and prints the acceleration in g, tab-separated (DISP_COOLTERM_S). The first 16 lines ramp while the window fills. Both boards that build it have a dead or absent LSM9DS1 on the bench (Alastor_H743, and Asmodee_H747 per the user, 2026-11-09): there every raw value equals the bias taken at start-up, so x and y print exactly 0.000000 and z a constant -0.999912. The first row checks that the application runs; the second, which needs --have imu, that the sensor moves.

tests.note: a board lying flat reads about 1 g on z, and a live sensor never gives x and y of exactly 0.000000 for long; not yet run on a board with a working LSM9DS1
